entry.title: Bill 2920 (Kauaʻi): — → Second Reading
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 5, Article 2, Section 5-2.6 Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating To Beautification Fees, to offset the tourism-related impacts of rental or U-drive motor vehicles by standardizing the beautification fee assessed to all motor vehicles in the County at five dollars ($5) per certificate of registration
